overview: The Council approved $627,000 in Community Preservation Act funding for various city projects and passed resolutions regarding board transparency, IT security, and a police vehicle replacement plan.

items.title: Salvato Family and Espresso Pizza Recognition
items.summary: Approved a resolution expressing gratitude to the Salvato family for 40 years of operating Espresso Pizza and dedicating a street corner in their honor.

items.title: Transparency of City Boards and Commissions
items.summary: Approved a resolution requiring that recordings and minutes of all city board and commission meetings be posted on the city website for at least 36 months.

items.title: Executive Session on IT Vulnerabilities
items.summary: Approved a request for an executive session to discuss identified IT and data vulnerabilities and protect taxpayer information following reports of personnel changes in the IT department.

items.title: Proposed Subcommittee on Litigation
items.summary: Referred a proposal to establish a council subcommittee on litigation to the Committee on Ordinances and Rules to improve financial oversight of legal expenses.

items.title: Police Department Vehicle Replacement Plan
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting a phased purchasing plan for police patrol vehicles to replace high-mileage units and explore hybrid or electric vehicle options.

items.title: Findings of City Clerk's Office Review
items.summary: Requested that the administration provide the council with the findings and associated legal costs of its recent review of the City Clerk's office.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Funding Appropriations
items.summary: Approved four appropriations totaling $627,000 for fire station window design, housing authority redevelopment plans, park remediation, and theater accessibility improvements.

items.title: Routine Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved committee reports regarding the Election Commission and previous reviews of Community Preservation Act projects.
